title: This computer as a server
text: If this computer is always on, it can run your own HiveVoice with all its data: database, sign-in and files are here then, not in the cloud. You need Docker.
noDocker: Docker is missing or not running. Install Docker Desktop (docker.com) and start it, then try again here.
windows: On Windows this is not one click yet. Guide: docs/selbsthosting.md (with WSL).

modes.cloudflare: From everywhere through a Cloudflare Tunnel

tsKeyHint: login.tailscale.com → Settings → Keys → “Generate auth key” (reusable). Funnel must be allowed in the tailnet.
start: Set up and start the server
working: Setting up … (a few minutes the first time)
stopped: Your server is set up but stopped.
